decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the template reuse and location-specific branding and wording established for this Requirement. Package and price consistency belongs to the booking Requirement and does not require another template-state update.
Keeping packages and prices consistent across location websites does not alter separate per-location bookings, payouts, calendars, revenue tracking, sales tracking, or management control.
The decision concerns copied location-site structure and consistent booking packages and prices, not the master site's role, location listing, or routing behavior.

The reference to changing branding and wording describes permitted location-specific customization of copied sites and does not necessarily change the established Smash Room brand name or its application.
The source does not change the selected design reference or the simple, easy-to-navigate layout characteristics.
